feature: Enable peer-to-peer voice connectivity across networks
workflow_rationale: This is a feature enhancement that changes the primary connection flow from LAN-based discovery to WiFi Direct-based peer-to-peer connectivity. The WiFi Direct infrastructure already exists but needs to be prioritized and integrated with group code matching.

phases.name: Configuration Foundation
phases.description: Add WiFi Direct discovery and service discovery configuration constants to AppConfig

subtasks.description: Add WiFi Direct service discovery configuration to AppConfig
subtasks.notes: Added WiFi Direct service discovery configuration constants: DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS (30s), AUTO_CONNECT_DELAY_MS (15s), SERVICE_DISCOVERY_INTERVAL_MS (5s), GROUP_OWNER_INTENT (15), SERVICE_TYPE (_entercomm._tcp), SERVICE_INSTANCE_NAME (EnterComm). Build and lint checks pass.

phases.name: WiFi Direct Service Discovery Enhancement
phases.description: Enhance WiFiDirectManager with service discovery for group code matching and automatic connection

subtasks.description: Add WiFi Direct local service registration with group code in service record
subtasks.notes:
Added WiFi Direct local service registration with group code in TXT record:
- Added WifiP2pDnsSdServiceInfo import for DNS-SD service discovery
- Added LocalServiceRegistered and LocalServiceUnregistered events to WiFiDirectEvent sealed class
- Added registerLocalService(groupCode: String) method using WifiP2pDnsSdServiceInfo with group code in TXT record
- Added unregisterLocalService() and clearLocalServices() cleanup methods
- Added setGroupCode()/getGroupCode() methods with StateFlow for group code state management
- Updated cleanup() to call clearLocalServices() before stopping discovery
- Uses AppConfig.WiFiDirect.SERVICE_TYPE and SERVICE_INSTANCE_NAME constants
- Build verified successful

subtasks.description: Add WiFi Direct service discovery with group code filtering
subtasks.notes:
Added WiFi Direct service discovery with group code filtering:
- Added DiscoveredService data class to represent discovered services with group code information
- Added new events: ServiceDiscovered, MatchingServiceDiscovered, ServiceDiscoveryStarted, ServiceDiscoveryStopped
- Added StateFlows: _discoveredServices, _isServiceDiscovering for reactive state management
- Implemented startServiceDiscovery() with DNS-SD TXT record listener for group code extraction
- Implemented stopServiceDiscovery() and clearServiceRequests() for proper cleanup
- Added getMatchingServices() to filter discovered services by matching group code
- DNS-SD TXT record listener extracts group_code from service records and emits MatchingServiceDiscovered when group codes match
- Updated cleanup() to properly clean up service discovery resources
- Build verification passed successfully

subtasks.description: Add automatic connection to matching group code peers
subtasks.notes:
Added automatic connection to matching group code peers:
- Added AutoConnectionStarted and AutoConnectionFailed events to WiFiDirectEvent sealed class
- Added auto-connection state tracking (isAutoConnecting, lastAutoConnectAttempt, autoConnectEnabled)
- Implemented setAutoConnectEnabled()/isAutoConnectEnabled() to control auto-connection behavior
- Implemented autoConnectToMatchingPeer() with duplicate connection prevention, cooldown respect, group code validation
- Split validation logic into validateAutoConnectConditions(), validateAutoConnectState(), validateServiceConditions() to satisfy Detekt rules
- Added resetAutoConnectState() for cleaning up after connection attempts
- Added connectToFirstMatchingService() helper for initiating connection to available services
- Build, Spotless, Detekt, and Lint checks all pass

subtasks.description: Add group code state management to WiFiDirectManager
subtasks.notes:
Added group code state management to WiFiDirectManager:
- Added GroupCodeChanged and GroupModeChanged events to WiFiDirectEvent sealed class
- Added GROUP_CODE_PATTERN regex for validating 4-8 alphanumeric characters
- Added static validation/normalization methods: isValidGroupCode(), normalizeGroupCode()
- Added group mode state management with _groupModeEnabled StateFlow, setGroupModeEnabled(), isGroupModeEnabled()
- Enhanced setGroupCode() with validation, normalization, event emission, and skip-if-unchanged optimization (now returns Boolean)
- Added helper methods: isMatchingService(), clearGroupCode()
- Build, Spotless, Detekt, and Lint checks all pass

phases.name: Connection Flow Prioritization
phases.description: Modify ConnectionCoordinator to prioritize WiFi Direct discovery over LAN-based discovery

subtasks.description: Add WiFi Direct service discovery as primary discovery mechanism
subtasks.notes:
Added WiFi Direct service discovery as primary discovery mechanism:
- Modified startDiscovery(groupCode?) to use service discovery first with peer discovery as fallback
- Added startServiceDiscoveryPrimary() that registers local service, starts service discovery, and schedules fallback timeout
- Added connectToService(service) for connecting via discovered services
- Added ServiceDiscovered and MatchingServiceDiscovered events to ConnectionEvent sealed class
- Added helper methods: setAutoConnectEnabled(), getMatchingServices(), getDiscoveredServices()
- Updated stopDiscovery() and disconnect() to clean up service discovery resources
- Exposed isServiceDiscovering StateFlow for UI integration
- Handled all new WiFiDirectEvent types in event handlers
- Fixed MeshNetworkService when expression to handle new ConnectionEvent types
- Refactored handleWiFiDirectEvent() into smaller handler methods to reduce cyclomatic complexity
- All checks pass: build, detekt, lint, tests

subtasks.description: Add service discovery event handling to ConnectionCoordinator
subtasks.notes:
Added service discovery event handling to ConnectionCoordinator:
- Added auto-connect logic to handleMatchingServiceDiscovered() that triggers automatic connection when matching service is discovered
- Added shouldAutoConnect() helper method to check conditions (auto-connect enabled, not already connecting/connected)
- All WiFi Direct events are now handled exhaustively (no else clause needed)
- Added handlers for WiFi P2P state events, local service events, group code/mode change events
- WiFi P2P disabled event properly cleans up discovery state
- Group code changes during discovery trigger re-registration of local service
- Build verification passed successfully

subtasks.description: Add group code synchronization between ConnectionCoordinator and WiFiDirectManager
subtasks.notes:
Added group code synchronization between ConnectionCoordinator and WiFiDirectManager:
- Added setGroupCode() that propagates to both WiFiDirectManager and MeshNetworkManager
- Added getGroupCode(), setGroupModeEnabled(), isGroupModeEnabled(), clearGroupCode() methods
- Exposed groupCode and groupModeEnabled StateFlows for UI observation
- Enhanced handleGroupCodeChanged() to sync group code to MeshNetworkManager when WiFi Direct group code changes
- Updated startDiscovery() to use setGroupCode() for proper synchronization
- Added TooManyFunctions suppress annotation for coordinator class
- Build, Spotless, Detekt, and Lint checks all pass

subtasks.description: Add WiFi Direct service cleanup in stopMeshNetwork()
subtasks.notes: Added WiFi Direct service cleanup in stopMeshNetwork(). phases.name: Mesh Network WiFi Direct Integration
phases.description: Ensure mesh networking properly works over WiFi Direct interface

subtasks.description: Ensure mesh discovery includes WiFi Direct interface broadcast addresses
subtasks.notes: Enhanced MeshNetworkManager.getNetworkBroadcastAddresses() to include WiFi Direct interface broadcast addresses. Added isWiFiDirectInterface() to detect P2P interfaces (p2p0, p2p-*), calculateBroadcastAddress() to compute broadcast from IP/prefix, and helper methods to reduce complexity. Always includes 192.168.49.255 as fallback for WiFi Direct subnet.

subtasks.description: Add WiFi Direct interface detection to getLocalIPAddresses()
subtasks.notes: Added WiFi Direct interface detection to getLocalIPAddresses(). The function now prioritizes WiFi Direct (P2P) IPs by returning them first in the list, using the existing isWiFiDirectInterface() helper. Added distinct logging for WiFi Direct vs regular interface IPs.
